verdict.rationale: An in-browser interactive tutorial is a fair learning-curve question for a web framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a browser-based, no-setup interactive tutorial or playground. The starter templates in next-js-docs-11 and the migration guides are adjacent learning resources, not an in-browser hands-on tutorial.

support.subject: As a developer, I can try an in-browser interactive tutorial to learn the framework hands-on without any local setup
